entry.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says
entry.summary: Five people have been killed and 16 injured in a Houthi missile attack targeting the presidential palace in the port city of Aden in southern Yemen, which is the seat of the internationally-recognised government, officials say. Information Minister Moammar al-Eryani told the BBC that the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt when five ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace. 关键事实：Five people have been killed；16 injured in a Houthi missile attack targeting the presidential palace in the port city of Aden in southern Yemen；which is the seat of the internationally-recognised government

entry.title: France to go it alone on next-gen combat aircraft after FCAS collapse
entry.summary: PARIS — France will develop a next-generation combat aircraft domestically as a successor to the Rafale, after a joint project with Germany and Spain for a future combat air system collapsed earlier this year, Air and Space Force Chief of Staff Jérôme Bellanger said. The country now conceives the future fighter, dubbed Avion de Combat du Futur or ACF, as a national project, with a target of flying conventional missions in 2040, Bellanger told the National Assembly’s defense committee in a hearing here on Wednesday. 关键事实：PARIS — France will develop a next-generation combat aircraft domestically as a successor to the Rafale

entry.title: North Korea’s ‘Hunchback’ Submarine Makes First At-Sea Appearance For Missile Tests
entry.summary: North Korea says it has test-fired two types of submarine-launched strategic cruise missiles off its east coast, in what appears to be the first time its bizarre Hero Kim Kun Ok submarine has been seen at sea in a publicized manner. If the vessel truly was the launch platform, the tests would mark its first confirmed weapons trials and a potential step toward operational service. 关键事实：North Korea says it has test-fired two types of submarine-launched strategic cruise missiles off its east coast；in what appears to be the first time its bizarre Hero Kim Kun Ok submarine has been seen at sea in a publicized manner；If the vessel truly was the launch platform

entry.title: Army Wants High-Energy Laser Weapons It Can Put On “Any Vehicle In The Motorpool”
entry.summary: The U.S. Army is pursuing a family of modular and scalable laser directed energy weapons that can be fitted to any vehicle in its inventory. The Army is already fielding high-energy lasers operationally on a limited basis, including along the border wth Mexico , but the technology has faced continued hurdles to more widespread use in recent years. entry.title: Kratos combat drone completes first Euro flight, advances turbojet engine production
entry.summary: The California-based defense company Kratos announced this week the first test flight of the uncrewed combat aircraft known as the U740 Valkyrie over European skies, as well as the first successful flight tests of a new turbojet engine designed for small aerial systems. The U740 Valkyrie was developed through a partnership with the Dutch company Airbus in support of German and other European armed forces. In a joint statement , Mike Schoellhorn, the chief executive of Airbus Defence and Space, explained that the Valkyrie combined Kratos’ low-cost airframe with Airbus’ sovereign European mission system. “In an increasingly complex and contested threat environment, air forces require affordable combat mass today,” he said, adding that the Valkyrie will also support crewed combat aircraft with extended range, firepower and survivability. 关键事实：as well as the first successful flight tests of a new turbojet engine designed for small aerial systems；The U740 Valkyrie was developed through a partnership with the Dutch company Airbus in support of German

entry.title: NASA to Help Unlock Mysteries of Mars’ Moons in Upcoming Mission
entry.summary: NASA is playing an important role in JAXA’s (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency) MMX (Martian Moons eXploration) mission, to advance our understanding of Mars’ moons and build on the agency’s long history of exploring the Red Planet. The mission aims to characterize and determine the origin of Mars’ moons Phobos and Deimos and deliver a sample of Phobos to Earth. The MMX spacecraft is targeting launch from JAXA’s Tanegashima Space Center in Japan at 3:41 p.m. The MMX spacecraft is targeting launch from JAXA’s Tanegashima Space Center in Japan at 3:41 p.m. EDT on Monday, Oct. 19 (4:41 a.m. JST on Tuesday, Oct. 20). “The samples from MMX will bring forth paradigm-shifting science on the Mars system for generations to come, especially as NASA prepares to send the first humans to Mars,” said Nicky Fox, associate administrator, Science Mission Directorate, NASA Headquarters in Washington. “The NASA-JAXA sample curation partnership is extremely valuable, and I am proud that NASA Science is supporting MMX sample curation and will be sharing portions of these samples for study as we continue to expand humanity’s understanding of the universe for the benefit of all.” Scientists have long debated the origin of Mars’ two moons. The data and samples collected by the MMX mission will help answer essential questions about the origins of these moons and the history of the solar system. Another key part of NASA’s contribution to MMX is its scientific partnership with JAXA. 关键事实：NASA is playing an important role in JAXA’s (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency) MMX (Martian Moons eXploration) mission；to advance our understanding of Mars’ moons；build on the agency’s long history of exploring the Red Planet

entry.title: Shield AI Delivers First V-BAT to Taiwan Coast Guard
entry.summary: Shield AI delivers the first V-BAT autonomous aircraft to the Taiwan Coast Guard Administration, enhancing maritime domain awareness with partner AIDC. Shield AI press release Defense-tech company Shield AI announced the first delivery of its V-BAT to the Taiwan Coast Guard Administration (CGA) with its partner Aerospace Industrial Development Corporation (AIDC). Shield AI’s V-BATs were competitively selected by the CGA in July 2026 for its “Shipborne UAV” program. Shield AI engineers demonstrated aircraft setup within minutes, displaying V-BAT’s ease of operations and advanced technological capabilities for maritime security. CGA will utilize V-BAT as a ship-based capability to maintain persistent Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) for surveillance, coastal patrols and law enforcement operations. Vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) aircraft eliminate the need for runways and improve deployment flexibility while optimizing costs and reducing personnel requirements. Partnering to build local expertise, Shield AI will train Coast Guard operators and maintenance personnel while simultaneously creating a robust localized support system for the V-BATs with AIDC. “V-BAT will give Taiwan’s Coast Guard the maritime domain awareness and intelligence picture needed across the Taiwan Strait and its maritime borders,” said Brandon Tseng, Shield AI president and co-founder. “V-BAT already does this for the U.S. Coast Guard, helping intercept more than 100,000 pounds of narcotics last year alone. 关键事实：Shield AI delivers the first V-BAT autonomous aircraft to the Taiwan Coast Guard Administration；enhancing maritime domain awareness with partner AIDC

entry.summary: At least 7 crew members missing after drone attacks on ships in Black Sea Emergency teams are searching for 7 missing crew after two chemical tankers were attacked in the Black Sea. entry.title: D-Wave Delivers Advantage2 Annealing Quantum Computer to Italy
entry.summary: Insider Brief D-Wave has delivered its Advantage2 annealing quantum computer to Villa Saporiti in Como, Lombardy, Italy, with installation planned to provide European researchers, universities and businesses with access to the system. The Advantage2 system features more than 4,400 qubits and is intended to support applications in optimization, materials simulation and other industrial workloads. PRESS RELEASE — D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) (“ D-Wave ” or the “Company”), the only dual-platform quantum computing company providing annealing and gate-model systems, software and services, today announced at Digital Innovation Forum 2026 that its Advantage2 TM annealing quantum computer has arrived in Lombardy, Italy, for installation at Villa Saporiti in Como. The VoltaB1 Advantage2 annealing quantum computer will be formally inaugurated at Q-Alliance’s “ Quantum per l’Italia ” event on October 16, at the historic Villa Saporiti. “Bringing Italy’s first annealing quantum computer to Como marks a historic milestone toward making quantum computing a working capability for Italian innovation and industry,” said Dr. Baratz. That is how quantum infrastructure becomes industrial advantage.” The system’s arrival follows a €10 million agreement between D-Wave and SQT to deploy an annealing quantum computer in Europe. Once operational, the Advantage2 system will be accessible through D – Wave’s Leap real-time quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. 关键事实：with installation planned to provide European researchers

entry.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
entry.summary: Meta has launched what it calls the “most capable” open-weight model in the United States. Dubbed Muse Spark Open, the model also has the distinction of having been designed to work with Macs. The new model, which leverages 816 billion parameters and a 1 million token context window, claims to offer superior performance to other popular open-weight models, according to evaluation results released by Meta on Thursday. Muse Spark Open is natively multimodal and built for complex coding tasks and agentic labor. It has also been designed to run locally on Apple’s computers. However, you will still need a lot of power to run the model locally, with a requirement of at least 1 terabyte of RAM, per Engadget. The model will run best via the Mac Studio that comes equipped with the M5 Ultra chip. Still, if you can muster the memory, Muse Spark Open may prove a significant work horse for coding and other desktop tasks. Meta says that it paired the model with Muse Code, its AI coding terminal, and deployed it to various agentic workflows, including coding fixes for a Mastodon client that included “bug fixes, new features, [and] full build.” The company says it also deployed it in the service of running DaVinci Resolve, the high-end video editing software, revealing that the model was capable of reviewing and cropping footage. Open-weight models provide a number of distinct industry advantages that aren’t afforded by closed and proprietary models. 关键事实：Meta has launched what it calls the “most capable” open-weight model in the United States；Dubbed Muse Spark Open；the model also has the distinction of having been designed to work with Macs
